name: bo-lol
text: The bo-lol is a fright figure of Welsh folklore. People described it as an apparition of the bogey or bugbear kind. The term marks a class of feared beings rather than one named character. MacKillop records the word as a definition without a story of its own.

attributes.attribute: Welsh folklore apparition of the bogey or bugbear kind

okr.objective: Define bo-lol as a Welsh bogey-type apparition.
key_results: Classify the bo-lol as a fright figure of the bogey or bugbear kind.
Note that MacKillop gives the word only a bare definition.
